rules.question: When is a general deduction allowed under s 8-1?
rule_skeleton: Positive limbs: incurred in gaining/producing assessable income, or necessarily incurred in carrying on a business for that purpose
Negative limbs: capital / private or domestic / exempt or NANE income

rules.question: How do specific deductions interact with the general deduction?
rule_skeleton: s 8-1 is the leading general deduction
Specific deductions may apply even when s 8-1 would not
No double deduction for the same loss or outgoing
